mechanics.name: Flow State
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever a Generator is completed, gain 1 Token, up to 5. For each Token, you Bless and Cleanse Totems, heal, and unhook Survivors 13/14/15% faster.
activation: A Generator must be completed to gain a Token.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Increased each per-Token Bless/Cleanse, healing, and unhook speed bonus from 8/9/10% to 13/14/15%.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Generator completions build permanent tokens that increasingly speed Totem interactions, healing, and unhooking.
duration: Tokens and their action-speed bonuses persist for the remainder of the Trial; no expiry is stated.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Gain 1 Token whenever any Generator is completed, up to 5. Tokens are not spent; each one adds the tier's action-speed bonus to blessing/cleansing, healing, and unhooking.

editorial.summary: Each completed Generator permanently adds a Token that massively speeds your healing, unhooking, cleansing, and blessing actions, up to five Tokens.
useCases: Scale into faster heals and unhooks as the Trial progresses.
Improve Totem interaction speed in Boon or anti-Hex builds.
Use late-game Tokens to make rescue and reset interactions noticeably faster.
counters: The perk starts with zero Tokens.
Early-game value is limited until generators are completed.
It does not accelerate generator repair itself.
pros: Multiple useful action categories scale from the same Tokens.
Requires no active management after generators are completed.
Late-game bonuses can become large if the team has progressed well.
cons: Win-more tendency because the perk strengthens as generators are completed.
No effect on the objective that generates its Tokens.
Weakest during the early game when establishing momentum matters most.
analysis: Flow State received one of the largest numerical buffs in 10.2. Each Generator Token now adds 13/14/15% action speed to healing, unhooking, blessing, and cleansing, still stacking up to five times.

The scaling becomes meaningful much earlier than endgame. At Tier III, two completed generators already represent 30% faster support actions, while three represent 45%. Those are numbers that can materially change rescue and reset timing.
The structural weakness remains that the perk starts at zero. It cannot prevent an early snowball before generators are completed, and it does not accelerate generator repair itself.
Even with that caveat, the old lower-B evaluation is too conservative after the buff. Flow State should be one of the first perks an independent reviewer reconsiders upward.
editorial.verdict: A much stronger scaling support perk in 10.2. It still starts asleep, but every completed Generator now wakes it up far more aggressively.
